ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 80% low-intensity (black) and 20% high-intensity (white/cream) across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central and lower lobe regions. Large contiguous high-intensity patch on the distal right lobe. Scattered high-intensity mottling and punctate spots on the distal left lobe and along upper margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-10 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave curvature originating from the median notch and extending to the acute fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular high-intensity clusters (1-3 pixels diameter) scattered across the lower-central dark region, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct white linear pixel disruptions visible: two parallel vertical marks on the mid-left lobe and one prominent diagonal mark on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel rake marks (likely odontocete-induced) across the left lobe and irregular, jagged indentations along the trailing edge suggestive of prior tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive large cream-colored geometric patch occupying the outer half of the right lobe trailing surface.
